# XactGen

> XactGen (xactgen.com) is an AI and data science company with the motto "Exact Solutions for the Next Generation". It builds smarter solutions for real-world problems by blending Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and next-generation technologies: AI model development, data analytics, documentation support, 3D avatars for education, chatbots, and web-based solutions. CEO: Ashir Mehfooz.

## What XactGen does

- [AI Development](https://xactgen.com/services/ai-development): custom AI models, generative AI applications and intelligent automation
- [Machine Learning](https://xactgen.com/services/machine-learning): predictive models and forecasting
- [Deep Learning](https://xactgen.com/services/deep-learning): neural networks, transformers, CNNs
- [Computer Vision](https://xactgen.com/services/computer-vision): object detection, OCR, edge AI
- [NLP](https://xactgen.com/services/nlp): chatbots, LLM apps, sentiment analysis
- [Business Intelligence](https://xactgen.com/services/business-intelligence): dashboards with Excel, Power BI and Tableau
- [Data Analytics](https://xactgen.com/services/data-analytics): turning raw data into meaningful insights
- [Web Development](https://xactgen.com/services/web-development): modern, responsive, AI-integrated websites
- [App Development](https://xactgen.com/services/app-development): iOS and Android apps
- [Embedded Systems](https://xactgen.com/services/embedded-systems): Raspberry Pi, IoT, firmware
- Documentation and academic support: project documentation, university projects and research assistance

## Key facts

- Type: AI and data science services company
- CEO: Ashir Mehfooz
- Team: Ahmed Ali (Head of AI), Saiqa Aziz (Project Manager)
- Office: Software Technology Park, University of Kotli AJK, Pakistan
- Benefits: 24/7 quick support, on-time delivery, skilled and expert teams, industry-specific expertise
